subject.title: Group chat context handling can blur which messages are addressed to the current agent

question: Should this be solved as durable per-message target metadata in core plus Telegram, as a prompt-only mitigation, or as an opt-in history-suppression/context-policy setting?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but choosing the permanent sibling-bot identity source and target-state semantics changes a cross-channel prompt/context contract.

options.title: Durable Target Metadata
options.body: Add current-agent, other-agent, unknown, and ambient target signals to history and reply context, with Telegram population and live proof.

options.title: Prompt-Only Stopgap
options.body: Land narrower guidance like the open prompt PR while explicitly leaving this issue open for metadata work.

options.title: Opt-In History Policy
options.body: Add a configurable suppression or summarization policy for unrelated group history, accepting the new public config and upgrade surface.

recommendation.title: Durable Target Metadata
recommendation.body: Add current-agent, other-agent, unknown, and ambient target signals to history and reply context, with Telegram population and live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The current code history and open prompt mitigation both point to this owner as the best available routing candidate.
